_meta.description: Offline buyer metrics for all KS accounts (sell-side)
_meta.source: PRODUCTION.ANALYTICS.SALE_DETAILS + COMPANIES + CUSTOMERS (Cortex Analyst generated, ks_flag=TRUE)
_meta.new_buyers_month: July 2026 (first purchase in Jul, no prior purchase since Jan 2025)
_meta.churned_definition: Bought in Q2 2026 (Apr-Jun), did NOT buy in Q3 2026 (Jul)
_meta.aov_definition: Average order value = AVG(SUM(sales) per customer per day per channel_type), deduplicated by sale_item_id
exclusions: Dump/shrinkage accounts excluded (Rule 12: customer_name ILIKE '%dump%', '%inventory adjust%', etc.)
rules_applied: R5 (CUSTOMERS join - used COUNT DISTINCT for buyer counts, dedup by sale_item_id for AOV)
_meta.confidence: MEDIUM - Cortex Analyst generated base SQL using SALE_DETAILS+COMPANIES+CUSTOMERS joins. COUNT(DISTINCT customer_code) is safe from fan-out. AOV used sale_item_id dedup. Churned = Q2 buyers absent in Q3 (Jul only, partial quarter). New buyers bounded to Jan 2025+ history (not full history).
known_gaps: new_buyers_current_month uses Jan 2025 as lookback start, not full history - some 'new' buyers may have purchased before 2025
churned_buyers uses only Jul 2026 for Q3 (partial quarter) - will overcount churn vs full Q3
AOV computed as avg daily order total per customer per channel type - may differ from per-order AOV if multiple orders per day
Dump exclusion uses pattern matching - some dump accounts with non-standard names may be included
